I’m so proud to see the next generation of Missouri’s organizers energized and ready to stand up to fascism and advocate for our communities.

I am deeply saddened by the shooting that took place this week at the STEAM Academy at McCluer South-Berkeley in Ferguson, which resulted in the death of one teen and left another critically injured.

I’m praying for the victims, their families, and for all the students, faculty members, and community members who have been affected by this tragic event.

Happy Passover, St. Louis!

I’m wishing a wonderful Passover to our Jewish community here in St. Louis and beyond.

I hope this time of thoughtful reflection and remembrance brings you and your loved ones a celebration that is both meaningful and joyous.

Chag Pesach Sameach!

Happy Trans Day of Visibility, St. Louis!

Today, we celebrate the lives, bravery, and resilience of our transgender and gender diverse community.

But in a time of constant attacks on the rights and well-being of the LGBTQ+ community, visibility alone is not enough — the political moment we are in now calls for resistance and action.

We must fight back against attacks on trans healthcare, challenge and dismantle systems rooted in harm and exclusion, and work to build a future where all people

Last election, we saw AIPAC, cryptocurrency PACs, and other outside money groups spend millions to try and stop our movement.

This year, our campaign is mobilizing a grassroots movement to fight to resist Trump’s fascism, end his illegal wars overseas, and abolish ICE. But politicians who are bankrolled by the same MAGA billionaire donors as the president aren’t up for that fight.
